trajectory.patch:
An issue exists in `subsys/dfu/Kconfig` where `CONFIG_MCUBOOT_IMG_MANAGER` relies on MCUboot's `bootutil` library (`bootutil/bootutil_public.h`), but does not select `CONFIG_MCUBOOT_BOOTUTIL_LIB`.

Here is the fix:

subsys/dfu/Kconfig
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
config MCUBOOT_IMG_MANAGER
	bool "Image manager for mcuboot"
	depends on FLASH_MAP
	help
	  Enable support for managing DFU image downloaded using mcuboot.
========
config MCUBOOT_IMG_MANAGER
	bool "Image manager for mcuboot"
	depends on FLASH_MAP
	select MCUBOOT_BOOTUTIL_LIB
	help
	  Enable support for managing DFU image downloaded using mcuboot.
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
